title: Crypto misuse: krealloc in GCM/AEAD update leaks old inbuf without zeroization
description: wolfssl_aes_gcm_update (line 415) and kcapi_aead_update (line 369) use krealloc to grow the ciphertext inbuf. When krealloc moves the buffer, the old allocation is freed internally without zeroization. Fix: replace krealloc with kmalloc+memcpy+memzero_explicit+kfree+pointer swap in both providers.
